definitions.explanation: Done regularly as a habit or established custom, rather than as a one-time action.

examples.japanese: {習慣的|しゅうかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{習慣的|しゅうかんてき}な⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Habitual drinking is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{習慣的|しゅうかんてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧になっている。
examples.english: Morning walks have become a habitual part of my routine.

notes:
Derived from ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ (habit; custom) plus ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧. Describes actions or behaviors that are performed regularly over time. Can be used both positively (good habits) and negatively (bad habits). Often appears in medical and health-related contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {習慣的|しゅうかんてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: habitual behavior
- {習慣的|しゅうかんてき}な⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧: habitual drinking
- {習慣的|しゅうかんてき}な⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧: habitual smoking
- {習慣的|しゅうかんてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to do habitually

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧: everyday; daily — describes what happens in ordinary daily life, without implying deliberate repetition
- ⟦{恒常的|こうじょうてき}→恒常的：21226_koujouteki⟧: constant; permanent — emphasizes unchanging continuity rather than repeated habit
- {慢性的|まんせいてき}: chronic — used mainly in medical or problem contexts to describe persistent conditions
